name: Genie Magic

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Once per Long Rest, use a Magic action to cast a chosen level 1 Sorcerer spell with an action casting time. Use the ability raised by this feat. Treat it as cast with a level 2 slot at character level 11, or level 3 slot at level 17.

benefits.name: Wish Magic
benefits.summary: Once per Long Rest, use a Magic action to cast a chosen level 1 Sorcerer spell with an action casting time. Use the ability raised by this feat. Treat it as cast with a level 2 slot at character level 11, or level 3 slot at level 17.
benefits.text: Choose a level 1 Sorcerer spell with a casting time of an action. Once per Long Rest you can cast it with a Magic action without a spell slot, using the ability this feat increased. From character level 11 it's cast as if with a level 2 slot, and from level 17 a level 3 slot.
